pages.title: Stock your workshop
pages.text: Bring a stone pickaxe or better for Ariente ores.$(br2)Smelt or blast Silver, Platinum, Lithium and Manganese ores into ingots. Negarite and Posirite ores each yield $(thing)four dust$() when smelted or blasted. Silicon Ore drops Silicon directly; Fortune helps, while Silk Touch keeps the ore.

pages.title: What to keep
pages.text: $(li)Silver: common machine parts.$(li)Platinum: construction and armor.$(li)Silicon: electronics.$(li)Lithium and Manganese: advanced components.$(li)Negarite and Posirite Dust: fuel and crafting.$(br2)Keep both fuel types. More of one never replaces the other. Blueprints and ingredients are separate requirements.
